thread:
Leah CSM: Morning team — Kickoff for Aperture Labs onboarding (they go live with search re-rank by June). Want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a realistic timeline.
Jon AE: Thanks — sales notes: primary contacts are Erin (Prod), Sam (SRE). They care most about latency and privacy. Renewal window in 11 months.
Priya SE: Technical checklist idea: 1) API keys & sandbox access 2) sample dataset ingestion 3) baseline latency test 4) rerank evals. I can own 1–3.
Marco CS Ops: Proposed 6-week plan: Week 0: access + kickoff, Week 1–2: data ingestion & mapping, Week 3: initial evals, Week 4: tuning, Week 5: staging QA, Week 6: rollout + handoff. Risks: data readiness, SRE bandwidth.
Tess PM: Success criteria to track: a) <200ms 95p latency on 1k qps test, b) rerank NDCG@10 >= baseline+0.03, c) two business users trained + run 10 queries. Can we make metrics part of the dashboard?
Leah CSM: Yes — add to console dashboards and weekly status updates. I'll set recurring check-ins Mon/Wed 30m. @Priya can we confirm sandbox by Friday?
Priya SE: Yep — pinging infra now. If they need on-prem package, we should know this week.
onboard-bot: [checklist] sandbox_provisioned: false -> created task #4521
Jon AE: Noted risk: their legal team flagged data residency. Marco, can you surface the Private deployment options and rough timeline/cost by Thurs?
Marco CS Ops: I'll prepare a short matrix: hosted vs. dedicated vs. private + estimated lead times. Will post here with a one-pager.
Leah CSM: Great. Action items: Priya = sandbox + baseline tests (due Fri), Marco = deployment options + one-pager (Thu), Tess = dashboard metrics & alert hooks (Tue), Jon = keep legal thread warm. I'll send meeting invite for Mon 10am PT.
Priya SE: FYI sample ingestion script I'm going to use:
```
# sample ingest
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/data/import \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY" \
  -F "file=@aperture_samples.ndjson"
```
Leah CSM: Solid. If any blockers, drop them here. Cheers :rocket:
